title: Sahabin da ya juya baya
intro: Za ku gano labarin wata rai da ta rayu a inuwar annabci amma ta zaɓi hanyar da ta kai ga halaka. Wannan mutum ya zauna gida tare da ɗaya daga cikin manzannin Allah da aka zaɓa amma ya faɗi jarrabawar imani. Wanene wannan abokin da ya ɓace?
clues: Na zauna a tsakanin mutanen da suka ƙi kiran adalci, kuma ban yi musu adawa ba.
An auri ni da wani annabin Allah, amma ban yarda da wannan imani ba.
Lokacin da manzannin suka zo gidana da gargaɗi, ban yarda da su ba.
An umurci matata ta bar birnin tare da masu bi, ni kuma ban kasance a cikinsu ba.
Hukuncin ya sauka a kan mutanena, ni kuma aka halaka ni tare da su.
An ambace ni a cikin Alqur'ani a matsayin misali na kafirci, tare da matar Nuhu, a cikin Suratul Tahrim.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ta ci amanar mijinta ta hanyar rashin imani
An bauta wa gumaka a fili a cikin Ka'aba
An shirya makirci kan manufar mijinta
Ta ƙi yarda da annabcin ɗanta
trial.answer: Ta ci amanar mijinta ta hanyar rashin imani

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An halaka shi tare da kafirai
An yi hijira zuwa ƙasa mai nisa
Ya tuba kuma an gafarta masa
Ya zama mai imani daga baya
outcome.answer: An halaka shi tare da kafirai

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
